name: PdxEditDrawer
description:
A drawer hosting a schema-driven form to create or edit one entity: on Save it validates and emits
`pdx-save` with the values.

members.name: value
members.description: Entity to edit, or null to create a new one.

members.name: title
members.description: Drawer title; defaults to "Edit"/"New" by mode.

members.name: size
members.description: Forwarded to pdx-drawer — named preset (sm/md/lg) or a custom CSS width.

members.name: saveLabel
members.description: Label of the save button. Empty: the edit-drawer.save component string, «Save».

members.name: cancelLabel
members.description: Label of the cancel button. Empty: the edit-drawer.cancel component string, «Cancel».

members.name: busy
members.description: Disable the footer buttons while the parent is persisting.

members.name: getValues
members.description: The form values now, `{}` while the form is not built.

members.name: validate
members.description: Runs validation and returns the result.

members.name: isDirty
members.description:
Whether anything in the form was changed since it opened.

A drawer is not a modal — Escape and the ✕ close it, and both are easy to hit by
accident — so a host has to ask before discarding, and only when there is something to
discard. The host cannot work this out for itself: the panel is re-parented to
<body>, so a query under the host finds no form, and comparing `getValues()` with the
record races the keystroke that has not reached the form model yet. The form carries
this itself.

events.name: pdx-save
events.description: Save, with a valid form: the values, and whether the drawer was editing or creating.

events.name: pdx-cancel
events.description: Cancel, Escape, the ✕, the backdrop: the host decides, and closes by setting `open`.
